summary: Iteration 51: Secure Token Storage Migration & Auto-Balance Flights Testing. All 13 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend verification confirms httpOnly cookie auth working, Auto-Balance Flights button present on Students tab, Print buttons on Roster and Org Chart pages, and no localStorage auth tokens.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend _extract_token correctly reads from: 1) httpOnly cookie, 2) Authorization Bearer header, 3) ?auth= query param
_set_auth_cookie helper sets secure=True, samesite=lax, httponly=True, path=/
Login endpoint sets cookie AND returns token in response body (backward compat)
Logout endpoint clears cookie with response.delete_cookie()
Frontend AuthContext uses axios.defaults.withCredentials=true for cookie auth
Frontend api.js getAuthHeaders() returns empty object (no localStorage tokens)
Auto-Balance button has data-testid='auto-balance-flights-btn' and calls POST /api/students/auto-assign
print.css correctly hides nav, sidebar, buttons with @media print rules
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth migration from localStorage to httpOnly cookies complete. Backend supports 3 auth methods: 1) httpOnly cookie (primary), 2) Authorization Bearer header (backward compat), 3) ?auth= query param (for img tags). Frontend uses axios.defaults.withCredentials=true. All localStorage references removed. Auto-Balance Flights button calls POST /api/students/auto-assign. Print buttons use window.print() with CSS @media print rules.
